irregularities.title: Band 6 provenance requires independent confirmation
irregularities.evidence: The parallel receipt reports Spearman 0.99995 against an owner-mirrored GeoDAWN TC raster. Correlation is useful but does not independently authenticate organizer-provided bytes.
irregularities.resolution: Use the feature interpretation provisionally; verify provenance with organizer sources before relying on it.

irregularities.title: Range-rejection cause and exterior convention remain unresolved
irregularities.evidence: A previous upload reported a [0,1] range error. Local all-finite checks pass for this file; there is no file-specific portal receipt proving what caused that rejection or that this TIFF would be accepted. The organizer's public data guidance says outside-boundary values should be null/NaN.
irregularities.resolution: Do not submit a negative TIFF; reconcile the public exterior guidance with the authenticated portal before any future cleared submission.

irregularities.title: 24.63% USGS 3DEP 1 m LiDAR Coverage Gap & Tree Feature-Starvation Trap
irregularities.evidence: `lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif` covers 3,894,769 / 5,167,373 footprint pixels (75.37%), leaving 1,272,604 basin/range pixels (`24.63%`, heavily concentrated in NE fold) without 1 m LiDAR. Single-tree models trained on 1 m + 10 m features simultaneously allocate top splits to 1 m scarps and starve seamless 10 m features.
irregularities.resolution: Parallel-reported ablations only; the selected arm was chosen on these splits and was not independently replayed in this review.

irregularities.title: 99.95% Target Leakage in `derived_gdr_qfaults_v2_100m_u8.tif` & GDR `dist_known_fault_px`
irregularities.evidence: `derived_gdr_qfaults_v2_100m_u8.tif` overlaps `labels.tif` at 99.95%, and GDR CSV `dist_known_fault_px` columns encode full-catalogue distances.
irregularities.resolution: Hard-banned in `src/wbggems2/features.py`; verified by 332/332 single-feature orientation-invariant & missingness leakage canaries (`max AUC = 0.79251 <= 0.90`).

irregularities.title: Near-fault purge and halo are a hypothesis, not a proven causal mechanism
irregularities.evidence: Different negative-purge configurations were evaluated by the parallel run; the halo explanation remains unverified.
irregularities.resolution: Retain the ablation as a reported diagnostic, not proof of generalization.

irregularities.title: Synthetic `13GEMSDOE` Spacing-5 Calibration Lattice Covers 99.8713% of Footprint Within 300 m
irregularities.evidence: `r13-lattice-s5` places 206,895 grid dots covering 5,160,722 / 5,167,373 footprint pixels within 3 px, forcing >=82.34% literal forward overlap for any 37,654-dot submission.
irregularities.resolution: Reported transparently in dual scope: competing sparse detectors pass (`max 66.20% <= 70%`), while literal unseparated `gems57.uniqueness` overlap (`99.55%`) is preserved unwaived per `AGENTS.md`.

irregularities.title: Historical Focus-9 `0.2449–0.2778` Family Clone Saturation
irregularities.evidence: All 9 historical high-scoring Focus-9 files (`GEMSDOE24..36`) derive from `19GEMSDOE H19-5` (`86.7%–100.0%` 3-px dot overlap; `GEMSDOE25 == GEMSDOE30` 0-XOR identical).
irregularities.resolution: Regardless of selected peers, final overlap is 100% with WBG-C1 and 99.5538% with r13; both independently trigger STOP.
